rows.title: Film Review: Aimless Bullet (1960) by Yu Hyun-mok
rows.comment: It fully deserves its place among the classic masterpieces
rows.verdict_le10: It fully deserves its place among the classic masterpieces
rows.dek_lead: In the end, it doesn't matter whether you agree "Aimless Bullet" is the best Korean film ever. Nor it matters that in the time of its initial release, it flopped. It fully deserves its place among the classic
